title: spec liveness: template_manifest keys nothing reads (name, specVersion, skills, scaffold, visibility, publisher, isStarter) — enforce or remove under ADR-0049
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Filing gate: **(c) should-fix carried from a contract review** (#30980, review 6692597068 ③c). Enrolling `objectstack.manifest.json` in the liveness ledger as `template_manifest` (PR #30980) recorded 7 keys `dead`.

## 维护者速读

模板清单文件（`objectstack.manifest.json`）里有 7 个键，平台从来不读，或者只是读了提示一下就不往下发。按「要么执行、要么移除」的规则，需要逐个决定是让它生效还是退役。

## Readings

- `packages/spec/liveness/template_manifest.json` (after #30980):
  - `name`, `specVersion`, `skills` and `scaffold` have no reader of the file's value;
  - `visibility`, `publisher` and `isStarter` are read only to warn, and are never sent.

## Expected

- Per key: enforce (name the reader) or retire (ADR-0087, minor before GA). Use the `spec-property-retirement` playbook.

Serial: after objectstack#30980 merges.

Suggested-grade: p2.
